key_decisions.original_text: Proposer selection bug deferred to Hegota (or later); no fix in Glamsterdam
EIP-7870 remains a living document; update in place with fork-specific history rather than creating per-fork EIPs
All focil-devnet-* renamed to heze-devnet-*, all frames-devnet-* renamed to bogota-devnet-*
heze-devnet-2 slot duration stays at 12 seconds; quick slots (EIP-8198) included but not yet at 10s
key_decisions.context: 12s slot duration; 10s deferred pending broader client readiness

key_decisions.original_text: bogota-devnet-1 test release to tag B1.1.0 including keyed nonce consensus change; launch targeting Thursday
heze-devnet-2 includes EIP-7805 (FOCIL), EIP-8015 (remove eth1data), EIP-8365 (disallow 0x00 validators), EIP-8198 (quick slots at 12s)
bogota-devnet-1 EIPs: EIP-8141, EIP-8250, EIP-8272, EIP-7906 (frames, keyed nonces, recent roots, transaction assertions)
